# AU Corporate

> AU Corporate is a business advisory and accounting firm based in New Delhi, India, founded in 2016. It helps foreign companies enter, incorporate, and operate in India — company formation, FEMA/RBI and tax compliance, accounting and payroll outsourcing, Virtual CFO services, and related regulatory advisory.

Primary services: India market entry and Global Capability Center (GCC) advisory, assurance and accounting (IFRS/Ind AS), taxation and transfer pricing, FEMA and RBI regulatory compliance, accounting and payroll outsourcing, Virtual CFO services, HR outsourcing, risk and transaction advisory, business valuation, and arbitration/dispute resolution.

Contact: partner@theaucorp.com | +91-9999010513 | New Delhi, India

Full page index (every page on the site, not just the curated list below): https://www.theaucorp.com/llms-full.txt

## USA → India — Full Resource List

The US is AU Corporate's most developed country-entry guide, with a dedicated sub-page for most steps of the subsidiary lifecycle:

- [India Entry for US Companies](https://www.theaucorp.com/india-entry-for-us-companies): Overview — subsidiary vs branch structuring, FEMA compliance, and transfer pricing
- [Register a Company in India from the USA](https://www.theaucorp.com/india-entry-for-us-companies/register-company-in-india-from-usa): Entity comparison, resident-director rule, process, cost and timeline
- [How to Incorporate a Subsidiary from the US](https://www.theaucorp.com/india-entry-for-us-companies/how-to-incorporate-subsidiary-india-from-us): Step-by-step incorporation walkthrough
- [Cost & Timeline from the US](https://www.theaucorp.com/india-entry-for-us-companies/cost-timeline-incorporate-company-india-from-us): Realistic cost and timeline for incorporating from the US
- [US Subsidiary vs Branch Office](https://www.theaucorp.com/india-entry-for-us-companies/us-subsidiary-vs-branch-office-india): Entity choice comparison
- [FEMA Compliance for US Companies](https://www.theaucorp.com/india-entry-for-us-companies/fema-compliance-us-company-india-subsidiary): FEMA/RBI reporting obligations
- [Transfer Pricing & Section 482](https://www.theaucorp.com/india-entry-for-us-companies/transfer-pricing-us-india-subsidiary): Form 5471 and transfer pricing
- [Permanent Establishment Risk in India](https://www.theaucorp.com/india-entry-for-us-companies/permanent-establishment-risk-india): PE risk for a US parent operating in India
- [Repatriating Profits — DTAA & Withholding Tax](https://www.theaucorp.com/india-entry-for-us-companies/repatriating-profits-indian-subsidiary-dtaa-withholding-tax): India-US DTAA rates and withholding tax
- [Annual Compliance Calendar (US-Owned Subsidiary)](https://www.theaucorp.com/india-entry-for-us-companies/annual-compliance-calendar): The dated AOC-4, MGT-7, ADT-1 and DIR-3 KYC calendar
- [Closing an Indian Subsidiary](https://www.theaucorp.com/india-entry-for-us-companies/close-indian-subsidiary-strike-off-voluntary-liquidation): Strike-off vs. voluntary liquidation

## Australia → India — Full Resource List

A long-form guide cluster for Australian companies setting up and running a subsidiary in India, covering the India-Australia tax treaty and Social Security Agreement:

- [Set Up a Subsidiary in India from Australia: 2026 Guide](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india): How Australian companies set up a subsidiary in India: structure, FDI rules, incorporation steps, RBI/FEMA filings, the India-Australia tax treaty and compliance. By a Chartered Accountant.
- [Audit and Internal Controls (ICOFR) for Indian Subsidiaries of Australian Companies](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/audit-icofr): Statutory audit, tax audit, GST audit and internal controls over financial reporting for an Indian subsidiary of an Australian group. What to expect and how to prepare.
- [Australian Parent Reporting for an Indian Subsidiary: CFC Rules, IDS and More](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/australian-parent-obligations): Australian tax reporting that follows when you own an Indian subsidiary: CFC rules, the International Dealings Schedule, foreign income tax offsets, transfer pricing and thin capitalisation. A guide for Australian finance teams.
- [13 Common Mistakes Australian Companies Make Setting Up in India](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/common-mistakes): The 13 most common and costly mistakes Australian companies make when setting up an Indian subsidiary, and how to avoid each. Includes a pre-filing checklist.
- [India Subsidiary Compliance Calendar for Australian Companies](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/compliance-calendar): The recurring compliance of an Indian subsidiary: monthly, quarterly, annual and event-based filings under company, tax, GST, FEMA and labour law.
- [Contracts and Arbitration in India for Australian Companies](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/contracts-and-arbitration): Intercompany and customer contracts for an Indian subsidiary, governing law, arbitration clauses, the New York Convention and enforcing awards in India.
- [Documents and Apostille for an India Subsidiary (Australian Parent)](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/documents-and-apostille): Which documents an Australian parent must prepare to incorporate an Indian subsidiary, and how notarisation and DFAT apostille work for Australian company documents.
- [India-Australia Tax Treaty (DTAA) and Permanent Establishment Risk](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/dtaa-pe-risk): How the India-Australia tax treaty (DTAA) applies to payments to your Australian parent: Withholding Tax rates, Tax Residency Certificate, Form 41 and permanent establishment risk.
- [EOR vs Subsidiary in India: Which Is Right for an Australian Company?](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/eor-vs-subsidiary): Compare an Employer of Record with your own Indian subsidiary: speed, control, compliance, tax presence and when to convert. A guide for Australian companies.
- [ESOPs for Indian Employees of an Australian Parent Company](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/esop): How ESOPs and RSUs work for employees of an Indian subsidiary: FEMA reporting, employee tax, valuation, cost recharge and transfer pricing for an Australian parent.
- [Sending an Australian Executive to India: Visa, Housing and Tax](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/expat-visa): How to relocate an Australian executive to India: employment visa, FRRO registration, housing, banking, tax residency and permanent establishment risk for the parent.
- [Treaty and Social Security for Foreign Employees in India: DTAA Article 15 and the India-Australia SSA](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/foreign-employee-treaty-ssa): How the India-Australia DTAA (Article 15) and the India-Australia Social Security Agreement apply to Australian employees working in India: the 183-day rule, Indian tax residency, certificates of coverage, provident fund and superannuation.
- [Funding an Indian Subsidiary: FEMA and Form FC-GPR](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/funding-fema-fc-gpr): How an Australian parent invests in an Indian subsidiary: equity, CCPS, ECB, the 60-day allotment rule, pricing, and RBI reporting through Form FC-GPR on FIRMS.
- [Global VAT and GST for Australian Companies Selling Abroad](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/global-vat): How VAT and GST work for Australian companies selling digital services and goods into Europe, the UK, New Zealand, India and beyond: registration, B2B and B2C rules and compliance.
- [Hiring in India: Contracts, Payroll and Statutory Compliance](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/hiring-and-payroll): How Australian companies hire in India: employment contracts, provident fund, ESI, gratuity, professional tax, payroll steps and India's labour codes.
- [Incorporation Process for an Indian Subsidiary, Step by Step](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/incorporation-process): The eight steps to incorporate a wholly owned subsidiary in India from Australia: forms, order of steps, typical 4 to 6 week timeline and first 90 days.
- [India-Australia DTAA: A Guide to the Tax Treaty for Australian Companies](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/india-australia-dtaa): The India-Australia double taxation avoidance agreement (DTAA) explained article by article, with India as the source state and Australia as the residence state: tax rates table, permanent establishment, business profits, dividends, interest, royalties, capital gains, employees, relief, MAP and how to claim treaty benefits.
- [Repatriating Profits from India to Australia: Forms and Tax](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/repatriating-profits): How an Australian parent receives money from its Indian subsidiary: dividends, service fees, royalties, loans. Forms 145 and 146, Withholding Tax and DTAA relief.
- [Resident Director Requirement for an Indian Company](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/resident-director): Every Indian company needs a Resident Director who has stayed in India 182 days in the financial year. Who qualifies, options for Australian parents, and duties.
- [Restructuring, Mergers and Exit for an Indian Subsidiary](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/restructuring-and-exit): Options to restructure, sell, merge or close an Indian subsidiary: share sale, slump sale, merger, buyback, strike-off and liquidation, with tax and RBI steps.
- [Share Valuation for Foreign Investment in India](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/share-valuation): Why shares issued to an Australian parent need a valuation, who can certify it, the pricing floor under FEMA, and when you need a fresh valuation.
- [Subsidiary vs Branch vs Liaison Office vs LLP in India](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/subsidiary-vs-branch-vs-liaison-office-vs-llp): Compare the four ways an Australian company can enter India: wholly owned subsidiary, branch office, liaison office and LLP. Activities, approvals, tax and control.
- [Handling Indian Tax Notices and Disputes for an Australian-Owned Subsidiary](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/tax-notices-and-litigation): What to do on receiving an Indian income tax, GST or transfer pricing notice: first steps, appeal routes, DRP, ITAT, MAP and Advance Pricing Agreements.
- [Transfer Pricing in India for Australian-Owned Subsidiaries](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/transfer-pricing): How transfer pricing works for an Indian subsidiary of an Australian company: arm's length pricing, documentation, Form 48, methods, safe harbour and audits.
- [266 FAQs: Setting Up an India Subsidiary from Australia](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/australia-to-india/faq): 266 plain answers for Australian companies: incorporation, FEMA, tax, the India-Australia treaty, hiring, compliance, repatriation, ESOPs, M&A and closing an Indian subsidiary.
